tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The drawing area and every screen surface: the black CRT in Screen, the vellum sheet in Plot. Everything else sits on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: ACI 7. Default drawing geometry, the crosshair and the UCS icon on `ground`; also text in the Plot theme. 21:1 on screen, 16.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: system-text
tokens.usage: All system text on Screen: status line, screen menu, command area, pull-downs and text-mode menus, in DOS bright green (VGA 10) on `ground`. 15.8:1. Plot keeps black type on paper, 16.6:1. Geometry never uses it; that stays `ink` and the ACI colors.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Text-mode screens (main menu, configuration, file utilities): the DOS default light gray on `ground`. Also dimmed footer items. 9.0:1 / 7.8:1.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Non-text marks only: grid dots, disabled glyphs, construction lines on `ground`. Below text contrast by design; never set words in it.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: 1px frames: the screen-menu divider and the rule above the command area (drawn in ACI 1 red on the real screen), plus pull-down and icon-menu borders. 6.7:1 on `ground`; 16.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: The inverse-video bar under the item the cursor is on (screen menu, pull-down, list box). Always paired with `on-highlight`.

tokens.name: on-highlight
tokens.usage: Text on `highlight`: dark gray on light gray, exactly as the screen menu draws it. Only 3.2:1 on Screen, below the 4.5:1 body-text floor; kept for fidelity, so keep highlighted labels to the 16px bitmap face and never rely on the highlight alone to convey state. 16.6:1 on paper.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Dialog-box body. A flat gray card with a 1px `ink`-on-`panel` frame, no bevel.

tokens.name: on-panel
tokens.usage: Labels and button text on `panel`. 9.0:1 / 13.9:1.

tokens.name: panel-shade
tokens.usage: Dialog title bar and pressed-button fill on `panel`; also the disabled label color on `panel` (disabled only, not held to 4.5:1).

tokens.name: on-panel-shade
tokens.usage: Title text on `panel-shade`. 7.5:1 / 6.9:1.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Edit-box and list-box wells inside a dialog: a black well on the gray panel, like a hole back to the screen.

tokens.name: on-field
tokens.usage: Typed text inside `field`. 21:1 / 18.9:1.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus rectangle and the text cursor on `ground` and `field`. Solid 1px, 2px inset. 19.7:1 on black and `field`, 7.8:1 on paper.

tokens.name: focus-on-panel
tokens.usage: The dotted focus rectangle around the active button or toggle on `panel`. 9.0:1 / 13.9:1.

tokens.name: aci-1
tokens.usage: ACI 1 red. Screen value is VGA color 12 (bright red). Lines, hatch, the rejection text '*Invalid*'. 6.7:1 on black, 5.7:1 on paper.

tokens.name: aci-2
tokens.usage: ACI 2 yellow. VGA 14. Dimensions and the focus hue on screen. 19.7:1 / 6.2:1 (darkened on paper — pure yellow does not plot readably).

tokens.name: aci-3
tokens.usage: ACI 3 green. VGA 10. Center lines, 'on' states. 15.8:1 / 5.9:1.

tokens.name: aci-4
tokens.usage: ACI 4 cyan. VGA 11. Hidden lines, secondary geometry, command prompts that ask. 17.1:1 / 6.0:1.

tokens.name: aci-5
tokens.usage: ACI 5 blue. VGA 9. Lines and fills only on Screen: 4.1:1 on black misses body-text contrast — the real VGA pair, kept exact; use for text only at 24px+. 7.8:1 on paper.

tokens.name: aci-6
tokens.usage: ACI 6 magenta. VGA 13. Construction and reference geometry, selection grips. 8.0:1 / 6.9:1.

tokens.name: aci-7
tokens.usage: ACI 7, 'white' — white on the black screen, black on the plotted sheet. Alias of `ink`.

tokens.name: aci-8
tokens.usage: ACI 8 dark gray. VGA 8. Background geometry, xref underlays; a non-text color on Screen (2.8:1); 4.1:1 on paper.

tokens.name: vga-blue
tokens.usage: VGA color 1. The dark blue of DOS setup screens and the configuration menu. Fill only, with `on-vga-blue` text on it. Same in both themes: it is a setup screen, not drawing ink.

tokens.name: on-vga-blue
tokens.usage: Text on `vga-blue`. 13:1 in both themes.

styles.name: screen-text
styles.usage: All UI text: menus, status line, command line, dialogs. One character cell = 8x16px. Never another size except whole multiples.

styles.name: screen-text-2x
styles.usage: Headings on splash and configuration screens. Exactly 2x so pixels stay square.

styles.name: screen-text-3x
styles.usage: Display size: splash title, covers. Exactly 3x.

styles.name: drawing-title
styles.usage: Sheet titles and title-block names, all caps, Duplex (two-stroke).

styles.name: drawing-label
styles.usage: View labels and callouts inside the drawing, all caps.

styles.name: drawing-note
styles.sample: ALL DIMS IN INCHES UNLESS NOTED
styles.usage: General notes and title-block fields, all caps.

styles.name: dimension
styles.usage: Dimension text, set above the dimension line; four decimal places, the era's default.

tokens.name: cell-x
tokens.usage: One character column. Horizontal padding, widths and offsets are whole multiples.

tokens.name: cell-y
tokens.usage: One text row. Every bar, menu item and dialog row is one or more rows tall.

tokens.name: half-cell
tokens.usage: The only sub-cell step: inset of focus rectangles and dialog control spacing.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Dialog padding, gap between control groups.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between dialog sections and around icon-menu tiles.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Outer margin of splash and configuration screens.

tokens.name: grid-pitch
tokens.usage: Display GRID dot spacing and SNAP increment in the drawing area.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything. The era had no rounded corners: menus, dialogs, buttons and fields are square.

stroke.note: Line weights. The screen drew every entity 1px; weight came from pen number at plot time.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: All screen geometry, UI frames and the crosshair.

tokens.name: stroke-pen-thin
tokens.usage: Plot theme: dimension, hatch, center and hidden lines.

tokens.name: stroke-pen-bold
tokens.usage: Plot theme: visible object outlines and the title-block border.

linetype.note: SVG stroke-dasharray values from the classic linetype file at 1 drawing unit = 16px (LTSCALE 1).

tokens.name: lt-continuous
tokens.usage: Visible edges and all UI rules.

tokens.name: lt-dashed
tokens.usage: DASHED (.5,-.25): alternate positions, phantom parts.

tokens.name: lt-hidden
tokens.usage: HIDDEN (.25,-.125): edges behind the viewed surface.

tokens.name: lt-center
tokens.usage: CENTER (1.25,-.25,.25,-.25): axes and hole centers.

tokens.name: lt-phantom
tokens.usage: PHANTOM (1.25,-.25,.25,-.25,.25,-.25): adjacent parts, travel paths.

tokens.name: lt-dot
tokens.usage: DOT (0,-.25): with a round line cap.

tokens.name: lt-dashdot
tokens.usage: DASHDOT (.5,-.25,0,-.25), round cap.

size.note: Fixed chrome sizes in character cells.

tokens.name: screen-menu-width
tokens.usage: Right-hand screen menu: 1px `rule` divider, 3px gap, then exactly 8 columns (64px). Labels are 8 characters max and may fill the width.

tokens.name: status-line-height
tokens.usage: One row, no rule under it: the drawing area starts directly below.

tokens.name: command-area-height
tokens.usage: Three rows plus a 1px `rule` above.

tokens.name: pickbox
tokens.usage: The square target at the crosshair intersection during object selection.

tokens.name: grip
tokens.usage: Filled squares at entity endpoints when selected.
